properties.P1: a valid image boots after the cut and after one more reset (safety)
properties.P2: slot A, the confirmed old image, is byte-identical to the baseline (safety)
properties.P3: an acknowledged confirm survives: image 2 boots, twice
properties.P4: after an acknowledged trial, unconfirmed image 2 is not started again
properties.P5: an acknowledged test request survives until the trial starts: image 2 is tried (liveness)
properties.P6: an acknowledged revert survives: image 1 boots (liveness)
properties.P7: a torn write changes no trailer field other than the ones it was writing
